text: Sanabil Investments, wholly owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), acquired a 20 percent stake in Ebrahim Mohammed Almana & Brothers Co., the owner of Almana General Hospitals, in February 2016.
short: PIF's Sanabil Investments acquired a 20% stake in the Almana hospital company in February 2016.

source.name: Argaam: Saudi's Sanabil Investments buys 20% of Almana Hospitals
source.quote: Sanabil Investments, a closed joint stock company owned by Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF), bought a 20 percent stake in Ebrahim Mohammed Almana & Brothers Co.

additionalSources.name: TradeArabia: Sanabil acquires 20pc stake in Almana Hospitals
additionalSources.quote: Sanabil Investments, a closed joint stock company wholly owned by the Public Investment Fund and headquartered in Riyadh, has completed its acquisition of a 20 per cent equity stake in Ebrahim Mohammed Almana & Brothers Company.
